findings.detail: 'raw' is used as the callable in PyObject_CallMethodNoArgs() with no NULL guard, but it can be NULL via a __new__/subclass bypass of tp_init (T.__new__(T) leaves it NULL). A guard such as 'raw != Py_None' or 'Py_IsNone(raw)' does NOT protect this — after the bypass the field is NULL. Add 'if (raw == NULL)' (or initialize it in tp_new) before the deref.
